about: The planned module map of Sources/TUIkit (buildtime/split2/refine/plan-refined.md, revision 4, after the owner's answers of 2026-10-07). Read by Tools/ModuleMap/modulemap.py; see README.md for every field. Paths are relative to Sources/TUIkit; declaration rules match '<path>::<name>', with '(ext)' after an extension's name. Module names live here and in the generated map.json only: they are free to change until per-module products ship, and a rename is an edit here, then `assign --write`.

modules.name: TUIkitStrings
modules.contents: Whole files needing no TUIkit module: the SF Symbols name table, the inline-Markdown parser, the format styles. Also the localization service, its string tables and keys, the module resource accessor (it holds the resources now) and storage diagnostics; it needs TUIkitCore (Lock) and compiles beside TUIkitView.

modules.name: TUIkitTerminalHost
modules.contents: Terminal facts as values: the host, its identity, quirks and capabilities, the process ancestry and clipboard locality behind them, hyperlink and clipboard support. View-free; needs TUIkitCore and compiles beside TUIkitView. The probes that fill these in stay in TUIkitApp.

modules.name: TUIkitFoundation
modules.contents: The default: everything no rule below claims, plus what two or more leaves or the substrate itself use.

modules.name: TUIkitChrome
modules.contents: The window chrome the run loop draws: the status bar view and its items, toolbars, notifications, tooltips and help, the window chrome host. The status bar STATE that focus and controls write stays in Base.

modules.name: TUIkitEffects
modules.contents: Transitions (.transition, AnyTransition, the built-in and custom transitions), content transitions, symbol effects, visual effects and scroll transitions.

modules.name: TUIkitBitmaps
modules.contents: The bitmap path of Image: Image(_:) from a file or URL, Image(_:bundle:), AsyncImage, decoding, resampling, orientation, templates, the render cache, the image-rendering options. Image itself and Image(systemName:) stay in Base. Base no longer depends on TUIkitImage.

modules.name: TUIkitMenus
modules.contents: Menu, ControlGroup, contextMenu, menuStyle and the concrete menu styles, the popup and inline menu cores, the option menu (SwiftUI: menus and commands). The dropdown renderer and popup machinery stay in Base: the screen-selection Copy menu and the popover use them.

modules.name: TUIkitNumericControls
modules.contents: Slider, Stepper, Gauge, ProgressView: the controls that edit or show a number in a range; the track and indeterminate renderers they share, their styles and handlers (SwiftUI: getting numeric inputs, indicating a value).

modules.name: TUIkitTextInput
modules.contents: TextField, SecureField, TextEditor, their handlers, renderer, mouse handling, editing commands, undo, suggestions.

modules.name: TUIkitPickers
modules.contents: Picker, RadioButtonGroup (with its FormControlRow conformance), DatePicker, the picker and date-picker styles.

modules.name: TUIkitLists
modules.contents: List and _ListCore, ItemListHandler, list styles, row separators, insets and backgrounds, OutlineGroup, EditMode, row reorder, row shortcuts, selection context menus, the row memo Table shares.

modules.name: TUIkitGrid
modules.contents: Grid, GridRow, LazyVGrid, LazyHGrid, GridItem.

modules.name: TUIkitNavigation
modules.contents: NavigationStack, NavigationPath, NavigationLink, NavigationSplitView, HSplitView, VSplitView, Inspector, navigation destinations, crumbs.

modules.name: TUIkitPresentation
modules.contents: alert, confirmationDialog, Dialog, sheet, fullScreenCover and modal, dismissal confirmation, dialog suppression, presentation detents, sizing, background, interaction, traits.

modules.name: TUIkitForms
modules.contents: Form, LabeledContent, GroupBox, Card, Panel, their styles, FormButtonRow with Button's conformance (SwiftUI: view groupings).

modules.name: TUIkitSearch
modules.contents: searchable, search tokens and scopes, dismissSearch, search placement and toolbar behaviour.

modules.name: TUIkitTables
modules.contents: Table, columns, rows, builders, customization, outline rows, table styles, row drag and drop.

modules.name: TUIkitTabs
modules.contents: TabView, Tab, TabSection, TabContent with its builder and modifiers, tab styles.

modules.name: TUIkitColorPicker
modules.contents: ColorPicker, its panels and swatches, the gradient, tone-curve and channel-curve editors.

modules.name: TUIkitApp
modules.contents: App, Scene and its modifiers, and the POSIX console layer: the run loop, input, signals, the Terminal class, the isatty queries, renderOnce.

modules.name: TUIkit
modules.contents: The umbrella: Exports.swift's @_exported imports and nothing else.

posix.why: POSIX-only APIs that do not compile on Windows. CLAUDE.md (relaxed by the owner 2026-10-07) lets them live in any module, isolated (own files, #if os(Windows) arms, a small protocol), never in a module that builds on Windows today: the four lower modules, which this map does not cover and CI's Windows lane guards. The plan still puts the console layer in TUIkitApp by design, so a use elsewhere is reported, as information. Types count too: plan section 4 (K6) says Windows signatures must not use pid_t.
posix.informational: POSIX outside TUIkitApp is allowed when isolated (CLAUDE.md, owner 2026-10-07): reported for information, not a new finding

witness_pairs.why: A type's conformance to the first protocol must see its conformance to each of the second: a constrained default (`extension P where Self: Q`) is chosen where T: P is checked, so a Q conformance in a module P's site cannot see is silently not used (M3's blank render). Pairs found in the sources' `extension P where Self: Q` are added to these.
